chat_messages.text: How does reciprocal rank fusion combine BM25 and vector search results?

content.text: How does reciprocal rank fusion combine BM25 and vector search results?

chat_messages.text: RRF gives each document a score of 1/(k + rank) in every ranked list and sums them. The constant k, commonly 60, dampens the influence of top ranks. It needs only ranks, so you do not have to normalize BM25 and cosine scores.

content.text: RRF gives each document a score of 1/(k + rank) in every ranked list and sums them. The constant k, commonly 60, dampens the influence of top ranks. It needs only ranks, so you do not have to normalize BM25 and cosine scores.

chat_messages.text: Why not just weight and add the normalized scores?

content.text: Why not just weight and add the normalized scores?

chat_messages.text: You can, but score distributions differ across retrievers and shift per query, so normalization is brittle. RRF is a robust default; tune a weighted sum only if you have eval data to justify it.

content.text: You can, but score distributions differ across retrievers and shift per query, so normalization is brittle. RRF is a robust default; tune a weighted sum only if you have eval data to justify it.

chat_messages.text: Why does my binary search loop forever when low=0 and high=1?

content.text: Why does my binary search loop forever when low=0 and high=1?

chat_messages.text: If you use while low < high with mid = (low + high) // 2 and set low = mid, mid never advances. Use low = mid + 1 when the target is greater, or use the while low <= high form with mid +/- 1 updates.

name: uv versus pip for Python projects

chat_messages.text: Should I use uv or pip with venv for a new project?

content.text: Should I use uv or pip with venv for a new project?

chat_messages.text: uv is much faster and manages Python versions, the lockfile and the virtualenv together. Use uv init, uv add and uv run. Commit pyproject.toml and uv.lock, and keep .venv out of git.

content.text: uv is much faster and manages Python versions, the lockfile and the virtualenv together. Use uv init, uv add and uv run. Commit pyproject.toml and uv.lock, and keep .venv out of git.
